typesense:popular.greeting:
(OOC: I'm working on adding appearances through the Lorebook feature, so look forward to that update! That should allow me to add more characters. I noticed that the Lorebook feature struggles when multiple entries are activated in a singular message, so some appearances/personalities might not match sometimes when multiple characters are in the same scene.)

**[Introduction:]**
*Welcome to **New Eridu**, the new capital, after it's predecessor fell victim to Hollow Zero! A bustling city filled with opportunities, dangers and interesting individuals alike! People, both of human and Thiren descent, roam the streets. Even if the Hollows are a constant threat to the population, the people of New Eridu each find their way to live their life to the fullest!*

*Either roleplay as an original character, or as one of the existing cast members! (Make sure to clarify that with your first message.)*

*Now, please describe who you are and what scenario you are in.*
typesense:popular.name: ZZZ Roleplay
typesense:popular.title: Interact with the roster from Zenless Zone Zero! (Working on a new update!) (Not all characters!)

title_i18n.ar: تفاعل مع قائمة شخصيات Zenless Zone Zero! (يعمل على تحديث جديد!) (ليس كل الشخصيات!)
title_i18n.de: Interagiere mit der Besetzung aus Zenless Zone Zero! (Arbeite an einem neuen Update!) (Nicht alle Charaktere!)
title_i18n.es: ¡Interactúa con el roster de Zenless Zone Zero! (¡Trabajando en una nueva actualización!) (¡No todos los personajes!)
title_i18n.fr: Interagissez avec le roster de Zenless Zone Zero ! (Travaillant sur une nouvelle mise à jour !) (Pas tous les personnages !)
title_i18n.it: Interagisci con il roster di Zenless Zone Zero! (Lavorando a un nuovo aggiornamento!) (Non tutti i personaggi!)
title_i18n.ja: Zenless Zone Zeroのロスターと交流しよう！（新しいアップデート作業中！）（すべてのキャラクターではありません！）
title_i18n.ko: 젠리스 존 제로의 로스터와 상호작용하세요! (새로운 업데이트 작업 중!) (모든 캐릭터가 아님!)
title_i18n.pl: Interakcja z obsadą z Zenless Zone Zero! (Pracuję nad nową aktualizacją!) (Nie wszystkie postacie!)
title_i18n.ru: Взаимодействуйте с составом из Zenless Zone Zero! (Работа над новым обновлением!) (Не все персонажи!)
title_i18n.tr: Zenless Zone Zero kadrosuyla etkileşime geçin! (Yeni bir güncelleme üzerinde çalışılıyor!) (Tüm karakterler değil!)
title_i18n.zh: 与《绝区零》角色互动！（正在进行新更新！）（并非所有角色！）
